plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce single name concentration and build cash.
Add QQQI to 25% to increase income-generating assets.

conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower, steadier returns around 1.5% per month. The focus is on reducing risk and building a cash buffer, which limits upside potential but also aims for significantly lower drawdowns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs SOXL and SPAL to minimal levels.
Trim SPY to 25% to meet concentration mandate.
Slightly trim QQQI to 15% to rebalance.
Trim SMH to 5% to reduce semiconductor exposure.
Buy SNOW as a new position, adding a high-scoring tech name.
This plan balances risk reduction with selective growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% monthly returns by reducing concentration and leverage while adding a quality growth name. It aims for controlled growth with moderate drawdowns, balancing risk and reward.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet concentration mandate.
Trim QQQI to 10% to shift focus from income to growth.
Trim SMH to 5% to reduce semiconductor exposure.
Add to SOXL and SPAL, increasing leveraged ETF exposure to 6% each.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets higher returns around 4% per month by increasing leverage and concentrating in strong setups. Expect significantly higher potential drawdowns and the risks associated with leveraged ETFs, requiring strict stop discipline.

plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and build cash.

income.read: This income-focused plan aims for reliable monthly distributions around 1% per month, prioritizing capital preservation over growth. While distributions provide income, the Net Asset Value can still decline in market downturns.
